game_concept: A card battler set in The Kingdom – Harvest Fields, farm fields beyond the walls: the royal scribe must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before mischievous imps exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Harvest Fields: farm fields beyond the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Harvest Fields, repeat each round: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before mischievous imps exploit the gap. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the bugs_fixed value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about bugs_fixed to power up the royal scribe and open the drawbridge.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Uninitialized Hunt
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Harvest Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Harvest Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
